vm_tools: concierge: do not keep xattrs/fflags in VM exports When exporting VMs, do not attempt to store extended attributes or "fflags" (chattr-style attributes). The files that are being archived should be normal files, aside from having the "encrypted" chattr flag set, which can't be preserved in an archive anyway. When libarchive adds files with these flags to a PAX-style tar file, it creates extra sections that GNU tar doesn't understand, which results in confusing error messages when extracting the tarball. Disable them to avoid adding the extra sections when using libarchive's "restricted pax" format so that the resulting tar file is cleanly extract-able with GNU tar and other tar implementations. CHROMIUM: ar10k: mac80211: don't WARN on short WMM parameters from AP In a very similar spirit to commit c470bdc1aaf3 ("mac80211: don't WARN on bad WMM parameters from buggy APs"), an AP may not transmit a fully-formed WMM IE. This binary uses ncurses and invokes the host ncurses5-config to configure. However, the board ncurses5-config adds /usr/lib to the library path (instead of $SYSROOT/usr/lib). Since the binary is masked and not installed, skip building it. servo: micro + ccd on same instance (round 2). Note: This is a temporay hack as go/servoarch will provide the same functionality, however in this case we need this double feature earlier. Expect this to be gone with servoarch with the rest of postinit. This change adds a new layer to postinit to allow for servo micro and ccd on the same servo instance iff both micro and ccd are enumerated and on the same v4 hub. In that case, the servo micro is the main device, and all controls route to it. However, ccd backed controls are also available behind the ccd_cr50. prefix.
